# HIJAZI Apartments

> HIJAZI Apartments (شقق حجازي المفروشة) rents fully furnished apartments in Shmeisani, Amman, Jordan, next to Abdali. Every apartment listed is 220 m² with 3 bedrooms (one master), 3 bathrooms, a separate living room, a guest room, a fully equipped kitchen and a laundry room, and sleeps 7–8 guests. All apartments have high-speed fiber internet, central heating, 5 air conditioners (cooling and heating), a dedicated indoor parking space and free regular housekeeping. Minimum stay is 3 nights; monthly and long stays get a special discount. The location is close to Jordan Hospital and the Specialty Hospital in Shmeisani, and to the Islamic Hospital and Abdali Hospital in Abdali, so guests include families, patients and their companions, and business travellers.

- Location: Youssef Ben Tashfin Street, Shmeisani, Amman, Jordan (next to Abdali)
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/gfww6DooaC2uzFrt8 (coordinates 31.9758601, 35.898315)
- Profiles: Booking.com https://www.booking.com/hotel/jo/hijazi-apartments.html · Airbnb https://www.airbnb.com/users/show/554726817 · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/hijazi.apartments/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/Hijazi-Apartments/61596304963608/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +962 78 900 0444
- Email: info@hijazi-apartments.com
- Booking: https://www.hijazi-apartments.com/apartments.html
- Languages: Arabic and English

## Key facts

- Monthly prices (whole apartment): 3,250 JOD for one month; 2,500 JOD a month when booking 6 months; 2,000 JOD a month when booking a full year
- Time to hospitals (Google Maps, November 2026; driving depends on traffic): the Specialty Hospital 8 min walk (650 m) or 3 min drive; the Islamic Hospital 6 min drive (2.3 km) or 23 min walk; Jordan Hospital 7 min drive (3.4 km) or 29 min walk; Abdali Hospital 7 min drive (3.1 km) or 29 min walk
- Within a short walk (Google Maps): Jawharat Al Shmeisani Pharmacy (4 min) and Taif Pharmacy (5 min); Dunya Haya grocery (5 min); Ashour Al Shmisani Supermarket (6 min); The Nub, Vinaigrette and Trattoria (Al Qasr Metropole Hotel), Peking Restaurant (4–5 min); The Qyard and GEMINI Terrace cafés (5 min)
- Apartment type currently listed: 3 bedrooms, 220 m², 3 bathrooms, sleeps 7–8 guests
- Rooms: master bedroom plus two more bedrooms, separate living room, guest room, fully equipped kitchen, separate laundry room
- Beds: Queen bed in the master bedroom; the other bedrooms have two single beds each, and apartments 104 and 106 have one King bedroom
- Balconies: one balcony in apartments 104, 105, 106 and 107; two balconies in apartments 207, 305 and 309; apartment 204 has a balcony, a terrace and an indoor garage
- Internet: high-speed fiber, separate Wi-Fi network and password per apartment, full coverage in every room
- Climate: central heating plus 5 air conditioners (cooling and heating) per apartment
- Parking: at least one dedicated, secured indoor space per apartment, with smart garage access
- Housekeeping: free, usually every other day; towels changed and toiletries replenished; extra cleaning for a fee
- Security and access: CCTV, security guard, smart access for building, garage and apartment doors, elevators, wheelchair-friendly entrances
- Guest service: staff available 24 hours, in-person check-in, invoice issued
- Free on request: baby cot, extra bed, extra mattress, extra towels, extra pillows and duvets
- Paid services: airport pick-up, airport transfers, extra cleaning, laundry and ironing service
- Policies: family policy (unmarried couples are not permitted to stay together); minimum stay 3 nights; check-in by prior arrangement; check-out at 12:00 noon (late check-out on request, subject to availability); smoking and pets allowed in selected apartments only; events only with prior management approval
- Varies by apartment (ask before booking): smoking, pets, toaster, additional parking space
